sheets.title: A claim link on a device with no vault — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the link met the front door and kept its bearer in the address. After, the ceremony opens by itself: no unlock, no vault; it waits for someone to accept as, with the guest road and the Connect note on the route.
sheets.before: first render …/claim#token=osc_clm_…; front door (.unlock 1); focus on the sign-in field
sheets.after: first render …/claim; .unlock 0; h1 Accept a claim, Claim waiting (warn mark); focus on Continue as guest (176×44, focus-visible)

sheets.title: After Continue as guest — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the guest road sealed a guest vault and landed on an empty shell. After, it mints a provisional principal only, and the claim is presented once and shown for review.
sheets.before: empty shell, no h1, focus on body
sheets.after: Kind resource_bundle · Items 2 · Manifest; focus on Consent code (352×44); .go 44×44

sheets.title: Accepted — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The answer is a StatusMark, and it holds the focus. Still no vault on this device.

sheets.title: A drop link, Sharing off (the default) — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the unlock screen stood in front and the drop screen was not in this build's plan at all. After, the recipient side is always-on: the drop opens before unlock with nothing switched on.
sheets.before: unlock screen (.unlock 1); bearer and key in the address; focus on Unlock
sheets.after: first render …/claim; .unlock 0; h1 Open a drop; focus on One-time code (352×44, focus-visible)

sheets.title: Opened — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Decrypted here under the link's key; the key was never stored or sent.
sheets.after: payload shown, 1 ok mark (Drop opened), 0 .note; address …/claim

sheets.title: /device on the same empty device — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the device route sat behind unlock. After, it opens by itself and asks only for an Identity session.
sheets.after: h1 Approve a device, the Connect note; .unlock 0; focus on Connect

sheets.title: Connected and approved — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The code the link carried waited in memory across Connect; Approve device holds the focus.
sheets.before: unlock screen, no code, 0 ok marks
sheets.after: User code ABCD-EFGH, focus on Approve device (44×44), 1 ok mark

sheets.title: 30 s after switching Sharing on, follow a link to /device — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The shell's denied-route fallback sent any navigation from a section to a non-section route back to the vault. Fixed in the shell; the route resolves.
sheets.after: address …/device, h1 Approve a device, inside the shell
